pois.label: 观测网远端杆(标准型)
pois.detail: 主站外围 1.5~2.2 km 的无人哨兵:2.2 m 锥杆挂迷你热膜头,基座气压墩带鹅颈进气,PV+电池自持,UHF 鞭天线把分钟包回传主站。三脚配重袋压住,不打地基。
pois.detail_en: An unmanned sentinel 1.5-2.2 km out from the hub: a 2.2 m taper pole carries a mini hot-film head, the base barometer puck breathes through a gooseneck, PV plus battery keep it alive, and a UHF whip relays minute packets to the hub. Tripod ballast bags hold it down — no foundation needed.
pois.sim: 观测网三角定位账(sim_network_triangulation.py,蒙卡 N=4000):主站+3 远端到达时差平面波最小二乘反演前锋矢量——速度 σ 4-5%、方位 σ 2.2-2.8°(前锋 ~100 m 皱褶主导);最上风杆 2.2 km 给 73-220 s(1.2-3.7 分钟)提前量
pois.sim_en: Network triangulation account (sim_network_triangulation.py, MC N=4000): plane-wave least squares on hub + 3 remote arrival times retrieves the front vector — speed sigma 4-5%, heading sigma 2.2-2.8 deg (dominated by ~100 m front roughness); the most upwind pole at 2.2 km buys 73-220 s (1.2-3.7 minutes) of lead
pois.physics: 单站只能报「前锋到了」;t_i = t₀ + s·x_i 的平面波模型里,3 根远端是解出二维慢度矢量的最小闭合(2 站只有一条基线)——网才能报「从哪来、多快、几分钟到」,矢量喂给穹顶闭风口、吊装停工与发射场 hold;小时级尘暴生成预警仍归主站 τ 光度计
pois.physics_en: A single station can only say 'the front is here'; in the plane-wave model t_i = t0 + s·x_i, three remotes are the minimal closure to solve the 2D slowness vector (two stations give just one baseline) — only the network can say 'from where, how fast, minutes to arrival', feeding dome vent closures, crane stand-downs and launch holds; hour-scale storm-genesis warning stays with the hub photometer

pois.label: 尘通量强化杆(前锋哨兵)
pois.detail: 2.8 m 高杆版:双环电极数撞击尘粒、顶端静电球读摩擦起电电场——尘暴前锋到达时尘通量与电场先于能见度跳变,是时差定位里最锐的到达信号;琥珀信标闪烁提示大风作业区。
pois.detail_en: The 2.8 m tall variant: twin ring electrodes count grain impacts and the top ball reads the triboelectric field — at a storm front, dust flux and E-field jump before visibility does, giving the sharpest arrival signature for triangulation; the amber beacon flashes to mark the high-wind work zone.

specs.尘通量: 双环电极(计数/电流双模)

pois.sim: 前端与主站同账(sim_dust_flux.py / sim_efield_probe.py):晴天单粒计数 SNR 625、尘暴切积分电流模式(主站口径 41.7 nA);电场量程按 610 Pa CO₂ 帕邢击穿 ~28 kV/m 封顶
pois.sim_en: Front ends share the hub accounts (sim_dust_flux.py / sim_efield_probe.py): clear-weather single-grain counting at SNR 625, storms switch to integrating-current mode (41.7 nA at the hub's geometry); the E-field range is capped by the ~28 kV/m Paschen breakdown of CO2 at 610 Pa
pois.physics: 前锋的尘幕携带跃移起电的电荷,尘通量/电场阶跃比气压签名更陡——到达时刻检测得越锐,三角定位的时差误差越小
pois.physics_en: The front's dust curtain carries saltation-charged grains; flux and E-field step more sharply than the pressure signature — the sharper the arrival detection, the smaller the triangulation timing error

pois.label: 岩钉矮墩气压站(崖边型)
pois.detail: 无杆低风阻版,给杆子立不住的崖边与碎石区:0.65 m 仪器筒装膜盒气压计与电池,四颗岩栓直接锚进基岩,平铺 PV 加 UHF 鞭。裙边墩座防风蚀掏空。
pois.detail_en: The mastless low-drag variant for cliff edges and rubble fields where poles can't stand: a 0.65 m drum holds the capsule barometer and battery, four rock bolts anchor straight into bedrock, with a flat PV sheet and UHF whip. The skirted base defeats wind scour.
pois.sim: 膜盒与进气与主站同账(sim_baro_membrane.py / sim_inlet_filter.py):40 µm 膜片 0.1 Pa 级、进气低通 fc≈1.4 Hz——尘卷风过顶的秒级负压尖峰正是它蹲守的信号
pois.sim_en: Capsule and inlet share the hub accounts (sim_baro_membrane.py / sim_inlet_filter.py): the 40 um diaphragm resolves 0.1 Pa and the pneumatic low-pass sits at fc~1.4 Hz — the seconds-long pressure dip of an overhead dust devil is exactly what it stakes out
pois.physics: 地形高点的气压信号对前锋几何最敏感,但高点风大立不住杆——把仪器压扁、锚进岩石,是「测量需求 vs 生存包线」的取舍解
pois.physics_en: High ground gives the pressure signal most sensitive to front geometry, but high ground is too windy for poles — flattening the instrument and bolting it to rock is the trade between measurement need and survival envelope
